mapper.select:
select f.FINPROD_ID id, f.FINPROD_ABBR text from FIN_PRODUCT f where 1=1
and f.FINPROD_TYPE=#{finprodType}

select b.BOOKSET_ID id, b.BOOKSET_NAME text from BOK_BOOKSET b where 1=1
and b.BOOKSET_TYPE!=#{booksetType}
AND (b.BOOKSET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR b.BOOKSET_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by b.BOOKSET_ID

select f.FINPROD_ID id, f.FINPROD_ABBR text from FIN_PRODUCT f where 1=1
and f.FINPROD_TYPE=#{finprodType}
AND (FINPROD_ID like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR FINPROD_ABBR like '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND F.FINPROD_ID IN ( --金融产品交易，按资产类型分区 select a.finprod_id from trd_product_deal a where a.finprod_type = #{finprodType} union --回购质押品 select a.pledge_finprod_id from FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE a INNER JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID where b.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType})
